description.value: The Block at Railtown is a breakfast-and-lunch eatery on Baker Street in Nelson's Railtown neighbourhood, built around comfort food with a French flair and an unwavering commitment to local, seasonal Kootenay-region ingredients. Every item on the menu — from crafted sandwiches and chowder to espresso drinks and fresh-baked cookies — is made from scratch using produce sourced directly from regional farmers. For a touring cyclist arriving in Nelson mid-morning, it offers a hearty, regionally rooted refuel in the centre of town.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and provides consistent address (91 Baker St, Nelson, BC V1L 4G8), phone (+1 778-463-2017), and hours across multiple subpages, confirming the business is real and operational. OSM holds no address or phone to cross-check, but the website URL matches OSM. A notable name discrepancy exists: OSM lists 'The Block Eatery' while the website consistently brands the business as 'The Block at Railtown.' No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, charging) are mentioned anywhere on the website; the only amenity confirmable from the menu is at least one vegetarian option (The Goddess sandwich).
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records the business as 'The Block Eatery' but the website consistently brands it as 'The Block at Railtown.' OSM may carry an informal or outdated name; no address or phone in OSM tags to cross-check.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, actively operating restaurant in downtown Nelson with a live website and confirmed contact details — a practical refueling stop for touring cyclists passing through.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu includes 'The Goddess' sandwich (vine-ripe tomatoes, living lettuce, smoked Gouda, basil mayo) — a meat-free option. No explicit vegan or GF labelling found
